description: MainActivity Kotlin source file for the Android notes app. It manages the main interface, including displaying, searching, and navigating notes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the notes application; handles the display and interaction with the list of notes, including search and navigation to note details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures views, and sets up search functionality.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads the notes list when the activity resumes, ensuring displayed data is up-to-date.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the repository and updates the adapter.

methods.name: configureSearch
methods.description: Sets up the search view to filter notes based on user input.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters notes matching the query, updating the displayed list.

methods.name: toggleEmptyState
methods.description: Shows or hides the empty view based on whether there are notes to display.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on note items, navigating to the note details screen.
